scope: WARWIKI Clinical Evidence library gap list (65 trials in library on this date; SYNERGY, SYNERGY II and BESIDE excluded because they are being added separately).
method: Candidates from guideline reference lists on disk (AUA, AUA/SUFU, EAU 2026, NICE NG123, NAMS), the script leads warwiki-named.tsv and warwiki-rcts.tsv, and author knowledge of registration trials. Every primary and follow-up report was resolved in PubMed (E-utilities) on 2026-11-11; citation fields are from the PubMed record. guidelines_citing = guideline files on disk whose reference list matched first author plus volume and first page (or author and year), plus a few hand-confirmed matches; column-garbled PDFs (AUA ED 2018, AUA Peyronie, AUA testosterone, AUA IC/BPS) under-match. cited_on_site = WARWIKI docs pages containing the primary report DOI, PubMed link or title.

trials.name: SCORPIO

primary.citation: Khullar V, Amarenco G, Angulo JC, et al. Efficacy and tolerability of mirabegron, a β(3)-adrenoceptor agonist, in patients with overactive bladder: results from a randomised European-Australian phase 3 trial. *Eur Urol.* 2013;63(2):283-95.

trials.notes: Acronyms SCORPIO, CAPRICORN and TAURUS appear in review literature (e.g., Vij 2015) but not in these abstracts; trial-to-acronym mapping is from author knowledge.
